LanguageData.IcecreamTailHistoryMatriarch.lines.0: While managing the colony, the Nivarian Matriarch had a sudden inspiration:
LanguageData.IcecreamTailHistoryMatriarch.lines.1: if chickens can eat grass, surely they can photosynthesize.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailHistoryMatriarch.lines.2: She left them to it. 227 chickens died.
LanguageData.IcecreamTailHistoryMatriarch02.lines.0: That night, kp spent the whole evening going “oho” over the Lievarian incident...
LanguageData.IcecreamTailHistoryMatriarch02.lines.1: History remembers it as the Lie Incident.
